en.headline: Police arrest e-bike rider after Mong Kok crash injures boy
en.dek: A 35-year-old mainland man on a two-way permit was held on Saturday on six suspected traffic offences after an electric bicycle struck a 10-year-old and the rider left the scene.
body: Police said they arrested a 35-year-old mainland man holding a two-way permit in Mong Kok on Saturday afternoon after an electric bicycle struck a 10-year-old local boy and the rider left without stopping.

The collision was reported on Friday on Sai Yee Street near Prince Edward Road West. Officers said the boy suffered abrasions to his hands and feet. The rider did not remain at the scene to help or exchange particulars, police said.

West Kowloon Region Traffic’s accident investigation team and task-force officers reviewed closed-circuit television footage and identified a suspect. On Saturday afternoon they arrested the man on Argyle Street near Portland Street and seized an electric bicycle linked to the case.

Police said he was being held on suspicion of dangerous driving, failing to stop after an accident, driving an unregistered vehicle, driving without a licence, using a vehicle without third-party insurance, and riding without an approved protective helmet.

Police condemned leaving the scene after an injury collision. They repeated that electric mobility devices should not share carriageways with ordinary traffic and are unsuitable on pavements or cycle tracks. Using an unregistered powered device on a road, pavement or cycle track can breach the Road Traffic Ordinance, they said.

zh.headline: 旺角電動單車撞傷男童後逃去 警拓35歲內地男子
zh.dek: 警方周六下午在旺角拘捕一名持雙程證的35歲內地男子，涉嫌危險駕駛等六項交通罪行，案件源於周五電動單車撞傷10歲男童後不顧而去。
body: 警方表示，周六下午在旺角拘捕一名持雙程證的35歲內地男子，涉嫌與一宗電動單車交通意外有關。警方指，該單車周五在洗衣街近太子道西撞倒一名10歲本地男童後，騎手沒有停留協助或留下資料便離開。
警方稱，男童手腳擦傷。西九龍總區交通部交通意外調查隊及特遣隊人員翻查區內閉路電視後鎖定懷疑涉案男子，周六下午在亞皆老街近砲蘭街將他拘捕，並檢取相關電動單車。
警方指，該男子涉嫌危險駕駛、意外後不顧而去、駕駛未有登記車輛、駕駛時沒有駕駛執照、沒有第三者保險而使用車輛，以及駕駛時沒有戴上認可防護頭盔，現正被扣留調查。
警方譴責有人在導致他人受傷後不顧而去。警方重申，電動可移動工具不宜與一般汽車共用行車道，亦不適合在行人路或單車徑使用；在道路、行人路及單車徑上使用未經登記及領牌的電動可移動工具，可能違反《道路交通條例》。
